authority: Existing P0 workbook remains the sole master. This file is a non-authoritative change set prepared for in-place merge; it is not a second resource registry.

additions.name: Library of Congress Prints & Photographs Online Catalog（PPOC）
additions.content: 照片、版画、绘画、海报、建筑与工程图；官方说明目录覆盖该部门约95%馆藏、约150万数字化图像，但并非完整馆藏清单，部分仅缩略图或线下访问。
additions.access: 网页检索；URL加fo=json的JSON表示；可显示图像可下载，部分高清访问需到馆/复制服务。
additions.rights: 按单件Rights Advisory；LOC通常不拥有馆藏版权，不提供通用许可；No known restrictions不等于CC0。

additions.name: National Archives Catalog（NARA）—档案描述、数字对象与特殊媒介
additions.provider: 美国国家档案和文件管理局（NARA）
additions.content: 联邦档案描述、权威记录、数字对象元数据及OCR文本；照片、航空照片、地图、建筑/工程图、电影、视频、声音记录和数据集。官方AWS数据集说明超过261GB、超过1.48亿数字对象URL；说明页称数据截至2026-03-01并计划每年更新两次，文件名日期口径仍待核。
additions.access: 网页检索；Catalog API需申请Key，默认每Key每月10,000次；全量/分组元数据另由AWS公开数据集提供。API条款禁止全量抓取并写明不得缓存/存储API响应。
additions.rights: 政府公务作品在美国通常为公有领域，但NARA馆藏并非全部公有领域；特殊媒介可能含捐赠限制、第三方版权、表演权、隐私权等。NARA不授予通用商业许可。

additions.name: China - Kiangsu province - Shanghai. The Bund
additions.provider: Library of Congress Prints and Photographs Division
additions.content: 约1890—1923年上海外滩拥挤码头场景；Carpenter Collection；页面列JPEG约37KB及TIFF约1.6MB下载选项。
additions.access: 单件页浏览及JPEG/TIFF下载链接。
additions.rights: Rights Advisory为No known restrictions on publication；不是CC0或通用商用许可，按具体用途继续核验。

additions.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art Open Access / Collection API
additions.content: Global art and material culture across 5,000+ years; 492,000+ OA public-domain images; structured object metadata includes objectName, culture, period, medium, dimensions, geography, creators, tags and rights fields; clothing, furniture, ceramics, textiles, musical instruments and objects.
additions.access: REST JSON API without key; max recommended 80 requests/sec; Open Access CSV/JSON; current search endpoint v1.1; old v1/search was scheduled for retirement 2026-10-01.
additions.rights: Object metadata dataset CC0; images only for OA/public-domain objects. Do not infer image openness from metadata openness; third-party privacy/publicity/trademark rights may remain.

additions.name: Rijksmuseum Collection Online / Data Services
additions.content: 800,000+ reusable object metadata records, most with high-resolution images; online collection has 1m+ objects; Search API, OAI-PMH, LDES, PID Resolver, collection downloads and controlled vocabularies; Linked Art/EDM/FAIR data services.
additions.access: Search API and OAI-PMH require no API key; LDES, PID resolver, bulk download and SRU for library bibliography. Search API covers museum objects, not library/archive records.
additions.rights: Many items PD/CC0 for commercial/non-commercial use; some CC BY 4.0 and some restricted. Check each object rights statement; museum requests attribution.

additions.name: V&A Explore the Collections / Collections API / IIIF
additions.content: 1m+ object records and 500k+ images; strong design, fashion, textiles, furniture, ceramics, decorative arts and everyday objects; API supports search/filter/clustering; IIIF Image API and Presentation manifests.
additions.access: Collections API v2; IIIF Image and Presentation APIs; no key required in current docs but V&A reserves future authentication; high-res images usually max 2500px longest side/A5 300dpi.
additions.rights: API terms default to non-commercial personal/educational use; commercial API use requires V&A Images contact. Website non-commercial image use has size/percentage/credit limits; commercial image licensing typically paid.

additions.name: New York Public Library Digital Collections
additions.content: 1m+ digitized items spanning books, videos, maps, manuscripts, illustrations, photographs, audio and moving images; nearly 500k items marked Public Domain/No Known U.S. Copyright Restrictions; date/topic/collection/availability filters; platform moving toward IIIF.
additions.access: Website and item downloads; public-domain GitHub CSV/JSON metadata; DPLA bulk metadata; legacy Repo API deprecated from 2026-08-01 and no public API replacement planned according to official API page.
additions.rights: Metadata CC0 does not license described content. Rights states include No Known U.S. Copyright, CC0, NYPL-held/managed copyright and Undetermined; privacy/publicity rights remain; API terms limited to non-commercial use.

additions.name: Dress, American, 1840–49 (The Met Object 103551)
additions.content: American cotton dress, 1840–1849, object number 1980.246.1, Costume Institute; useful for dress history, textile materials, social identity and 19th-century everyday life.
additions.access: Object page and API record; Open Access image.
additions.rights: Object page marked Public Domain; The Met states OA/public-domain images may be used commercially and non-commercially without fee or permission, subject to other third-party rights.

additions.name: The Buttolph Collection of Menus / What's on the Menu
additions.provider: New York Public Library Rare Book Division
additions.content: About 25,000 menus, dates approx. 1851-1930; about two-thirds American, over half from New York restaurants, most 1890-1910; includes restaurant, ship and banquet menus; official NYPL guide says fuller extent digitized via What's on the Menu.
additions.access: Official portal and NYPL Digital Collections; some menus not fully imaged due binding/fragility; portal/API not technically validated this round.
additions.rights: Check current item-level NYPL Rights Statement; do not infer public domain from date/digitization. Legacy Repo API is deprecated.

additions.name: Lowell Folklife Project Collection (AFC 1987/042)
additions.provider: Library of Congress American Folklife Center
additions.content: 1987-1988 ethnographic documentation of ethnic neighborhoods, occupations and community life linked to industrialization: 196 hours of recordings plus about 23 hours resident recordings; about 10,000 B&W photos and 3,500 color slides; interviews, festivals, religious services, music, parades, ethnic restaurants, neighborhood tours, field notes, questionnaires, maps, reports and transcripts. Most audio/photos online; remainder in reading room.
additions.access: Online collection and finding aid; some materials require Folklife Reading Room or formal request.
additions.rights: Recording rights may belong to performers, descendants/estates, donors, radio stations or traditional communities; written permission may be required for duplication/distribution; ethical/community considerations apply.

additions.name: National Jukebox
additions.provider: Library of Congress National Audio-Visual Conservation Center
additions.content: About 20,150 recordings from 1900-1925 across popular music, ethnic music, opera, classical, musical theater, religious and other genres; about 6,000 recordings downloadable, remainder available by streaming.
additions.access: LOC streaming catalogue; Citizen DJ selected public-domain audio subsets and bulk samples.
additions.rights: Streaming license does not grant download/reuse rights. Pre-1923 recordings entered US public domain under MMA; 1923-1946 protected 100 years, 1947-1956 protected 110 years. Check each recording; Citizen DJ public-domain subset does not represent the whole catalogue.

additions.name: JSTOR Open Content / Early Journal Content / Open Access Books
additions.content: Academic journals, books, chapters, images and primary sources; Open JSTOR Collection includes Early Journal Content, OA Content, Reveal Digital and Open Artstor; 9,000+ OA ebooks; EJC uses rolling 95-year US / 143-year international publication threshold.
additions.access: Open Content free; individual free account has limited read-only; institutional subscription; OA books with item-level CC license; EJC text analysis by application.
additions.rights: Free reading is not open license; OA ebooks have individual CC licenses; JSTOR Text Analysis Support is non-commercial academic/educational only and prohibits commercial use and LLM training/fine-tuning.

additions.name: Directory of Open Access Books (DOAB)
additions.content: Discovery directory of peer-reviewed open access academic books, with title, author, publisher, subject, date, language, DOI/persistent link, license and full-text URL metadata. DOAB is a discovery/link directory, not host for all full texts.
additions.access: Web search, metadata feeds, MARCXML/KBART/ONIX/JSON/CSV, OAI-PMH, selective export and API.
additions.rights: DOAB metadata CC0; book full-text license is determined by publisher/host per title.

additions.name: OAPEN Library
additions.content: Curated quality-controlled open access scholarly books; hosts full texts and preservation, plus metadata. Metadata feeds daily; book and chapter records may or may not contain full-text links.
additions.access: Full-text pages; MARCXML, KBART, ONIX, JSON, CSV, RIS; OAI-PMH; selective export up to about 500 titles.
additions.rights: Metadata CC0; full-text rights vary by book and publisher; do not assume all titles CC0.

additions.name: OpenAlex
additions.content: Global scholarly catalog/graph of works, authors, sources, institutions and topics; core corpus 300M+ works; expansion corpus increases coverage; citations, references, author/institution/topic relations, OA locations and license metadata.
additions.access: Free REST API without key; free API key raises daily budget 10x; anonymous S3 snapshot in JSONL/Parquet; free public snapshot quarterly.
additions.rights: OpenAlex metadata CC0; OA license is attached to each work location and can be CC BY, NC, ND, CC0/public-domain, other-oa or publisher-specific-oa. Metadata CC0 does not license linked full text.

additions.name: Archaeology Data Service (ADS)
additions.provider: University of York / Archaeology Data Service
additions.content: UK archaeology and historic environment digital repository; Data Catalogue for monuments/events, ADS Library for reports/books/articles, ADS Archives for raw project data; archives may include excavation reports, fieldwork data, GIS, photos, aerial imagery, maps, models and primary records.
additions.access: Three search portals; collection download pages; DOI citations; not every catalogue record has a downloadable object.
additions.rights: Free access; reuse license varies per dataset: CC BY 4.0, OGL, other CC or legacy ADS terms. Older terms require attribution and prohibit selling materials; commercial use must be checked per dataset.

additions.name: ARIADNE Portal
additions.content: Cross-institution archaeological resource catalogue with fieldwork reports, research papers, scientific datasets, sites/monuments, artefacts, inscriptions and burial data; over 2m records by official description and portal index currently displays over 4m resources; filters by time/place/resource type/provider; AO-Cat based on CIDOC CRM and linked vocabularies.
additions.access: Web portal and metadata search; individual records link to source provider's resource.
additions.rights: Portal mainly provides metadata; source data and licensing are controlled by the original provider. Searchability does not imply downloadable or commercial reuse rights.

additions.name: Open Context
additions.provider: Alexandria Archive Institute / California Digital Library preservation
additions.content: Open archaeological/anthropological research data publishing: field notes, diaries, images, maps, vocabularies, typologies, artefact/ecofact data; stable item IDs and dataset DOIs; linked open data relations; faceted/map-based discovery.
additions.access: Web search, map visualization, data table downloads, JSON-LD record/search APIs, DOI citations; archived by California Digital Library.
additions.rights: Free access; each dataset has its own Creative Commons/open license and community/privacy conditions. Publisher pays one-time data publishing/preservation fees (examples $350/$1,000/$5,000); not an access fee for users.

additions.name: David Rumsey Map Collection
additions.provider: David Rumsey Map Center / Stanford University Libraries
additions.content: 152,373 maps and images; global regions, scales and historical periods; some georeferenced maps can overlay modern earth/maps; selected KML/Google Earth/Maps.
additions.access: Web search/view; downloadable full-resolution JP2 through Export/Download 1 where a Download button exists; selected Google Earth/Maps overlays.
additions.rights: Map images may be used free in personal and print/digital publications including for-profit/nonprofit; stand-alone facsimile sales require permission; post-1929 maps may remain copyrighted; no Download button means display only.

additions.name: World Historical Gazetteer (WHG)
additions.provider: World Historical Gazetteer / University of Pittsburgh
additions.content: Historical place index and graph across time/languages: places, aliases, types, geometry, temporal bounds, sources, links and relations; sources include GeoNames, Getty TGN, Wikidata, CHGIS, D-PLACE and Digital Gazetteer of the Song Dynasty.
additions.access: Public web browse; v4 Entity and Reconciliation APIs (most endpoints require token); read-only public data via MCP; JSON/Linked Places Format.
additions.rights: No blanket license; each source namespace retains its own terms (GeoNames CC BY, Wikidata CC0, OSM ODbL, Getty TGN ODC-By, some non-commercial); WHG curation license is alongside, not instead of, source terms.

additions.name: Pleiades Ancient Places Gazetteer
additions.provider: Institute for the Study of the Ancient World / NYU
additions.content: Ancient places gazetteer/graph with places, locations, ancient/modern names, connections, types, dates and bibliography; 2025-05-28 v4.1 release contained 41,480 citable place resources; updates continue in Nov 2026.
additions.access: No login; item JSON/API; daily full JSON, weekly RDF, quarterly numbered release; GIS CSV/KML/RDF downloads.
additions.rights: CC BY 3.0, share/adapt/commercial use with attribution; use numbered releases for static scholarly work, live/daily data for current status.

additions.name: Harvard Geospatial Library / Harvard Map Collection
additions.content: Terabytes of global geospatial data at all scales; demographic, physical and thematic data; thousands of scanned maps as GeoTIFF, including many public-domain historical maps and modern topographic sets.
additions.access: Harvard Geospatial Library search/download; HOLLIS discovery; some restricted materials require Map Collection Reading Room access/request.
additions.rights: Some historical maps public domain; modern topographic and licensed GIS data restricted; HGL does not include all holdings; per-dataset access/rights check required.

additions.level: 档案人物/家族/组织发现平台
additions.name: Social Networks and Archival Context (SNAC)
additions.content: Global discovery of historical persons, families and corporate bodies in cultural heritage archival descriptions; members link identities and archival resources such as photos, letters, sound recordings and collections.
additions.access: Free web search, SNAC API, API commands/examples, OpenRefine endpoint; links to original repositories.
additions.rights: SNAC descriptive records CC0 1.0; SNAC does not own/store original materials; original archive rights controlled by contributing institution.

additions.name: Virtual International Authority File (VIAF)
additions.content: Links authority data from 37 agencies in 29 countries; cluster records aggregate multilingual names for the same entity; source records retain original authority entries and see/see-also links.
additions.access: Production API search by keyword/local/preferred name/title/source/control number; MARC21/UNIMARC source records.
additions.rights: VIAF data under ODC-By; preserve original agency and control number; authority linking is not a full biography/social graph.

additions.name: Getty Union List of Artist Names (ULAN)
additions.provider: J. Paul Getty Trust / Getty Research Institute
additions.content: Authority names, variants, roles, nationality/culture, dates, biographies and relationships for artists, architects, craftspeople, studios, patrons and institutions; not a general all-person database.
additions.access: Web search; SPARQL; OpenRefine; JSON/RDF/N3/Turtle/N-Triples; full AAT/TGN/ULAN N-Triples monthly.
additions.rights: ODC-By 1.0 with attribution; does not license linked images or third-party biographies; old XML web services discontinued in 2026.

additions.name: People of Medieval Scotland (PoMS) 1093-1371
additions.provider: University of Glasgow / King's College London / University of Edinburgh
additions.content: Known Scottish people 1093-1314 with extension to 1371, based on 8,600+ contemporary documents; person, role, date, factoid, charter, land transaction, relationship, source institution; network visualization and maps.
additions.access: Free web database, person/place/source/factoid search, network graph/map; KDL RDF/OWL dump (2020 snapshot).
additions.rights: KDL dataset catalog labels RDF data CC BY; original charter images and documents require source repository rights check; 2020 RDF dump is historical snapshot.

additions.name: Prosopography of Anglo-Saxon England (PASE)
additions.provider: University of Oxford History Faculty / University of Cambridge
additions.content: Relational database of recorded inhabitants of England from late 6th to late 11th centuries, based on chronicles, saints' lives, charters, libri vitae, inscriptions, Domesday Book and coins; supports person, relation and group search.
additions.access: Free web relational database; no public API/bulk download confirmed.
additions.rights: Public browsing confirmed; overall open license/commercial reuse terms not located; treat bulk and commercial reuse as unconfirmed.

additions.name: Prosopography of the Byzantine World (PBW)
additions.provider: King's College London / British Academy / Oxford Digital Humanities
additions.content: Byzantine persons 1025-1204 and relevant non-Byzantine persons; historical database version contains about 60,000 factoids, 2,774 narrative units, 7,500 seals and 5,000 matrices linked to persons, dates, reigns, events and repositories.
additions.access: Online academic database; no public bulk API or open data license confirmed; personal access and limited academic use described by library guides.
additions.rights: Not an open dataset; limited personal research/quotation only; commercial or bulk reuse requires permission; current database version status needs recheck.

additions.name: IIIF Image/Presentation/Content Search/Change Discovery APIs
additions.content: Image API 3.0.0 for region/size/rotation/quality/format and info.json; Presentation API 3.0.0 for compound objects/Manifest/canvas/annotations; Content Search 2.0; Change Discovery 1.0; Authorization Flow 2.0.
additions.access: Standards documents and provider-hosted Image API, Presentation Manifest, info.json, Content Search and auth services.
additions.rights: IIIF spec text open licensed; underlying image rights/authentication controlled by source institution. IIIF does not grant image copyright.

additions.name: PAGE-XML (PRImA / OCR-D PAGE)
additions.content: XML format for page layout and recognition results: page boundaries, regions, reading order, TextRegion/TextLine/Word/Glyph, UTF-8 text, confidence, AlternativeImage and processing history; OCR-D uses PAGE as primary exchange format with METS.
additions.access: Open PAGE schema/docs, OCR-D conventions, METS/PAGE guidance.
additions.rights: Format spec open; original images and recognition text remain under source provider rights. PAGE is not an OCR engine or content license.

additions.name: ALTO XML (Analyzed Layout and Text Object)
additions.content: LOC-maintained XML schema for printed page layout and OCR content: page/text block/line/word coordinates, styles, reading order, language and rotation; ALTO 4.4 official schema published 2023-04-07, while page summary still labels current 4.3.
additions.access: Official LOC schemas, versioned XSD, ALTO in Action examples, METS integration.
additions.rights: ALTO standard text CC BY-SA 4.0 since v4.0; images/OCR text in ALTO files remain source-controlled.

additions.name: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (Sentinel)
additions.content: Sentinel-1 radar, Sentinel-2 multispectral, Sentinel-3 land/ocean and Sentinel-5P atmospheric data; search, visualize, download and cloud processing; useful for landform, hydrology, vegetation, shoreline and land-use change.
additions.access: OData, STAC 1.1.0, Sentinel Hub Catalog API, openEO; new STAC v1 endpoint, legacy endpoint deprecated 2025-11-17.
additions.rights: Sentinel data free/full/open under Sentinel Data Legal Notice; other portal content non-commercial and not for resale/redistribution. Do not conflate Sentinel data with portal content.

additions.name: USGS Landsat / EarthExplorer / EROS Archive
additions.provider: United States Geological Survey / EROS Center
additions.content: USGS EROS holds Landsat observations 1972-present and aerial photos from 1937; EarthExplorer searches 120+ datasets; Landsat Collection 2 includes L1/L2/ARD/DEM/reflectance/temperature.
additions.access: EarthExplorer web search/download, M2M REST JSON API, bulk download, AWS cloud/STAC, ESPA on-demand processing.
additions.rights: USGS Landsat data free and public domain with attribution; other EarthExplorer datasets may have different rights and must be checked individually.

additions.level: 三维文化遗产数据平台
additions.name: Open Heritage 3D (CyArk)
additions.content: Hundreds of 3D cultural heritage datasets including LiDAR point clouds, photogrammetric imagery and spatial data; examples include Carthage Amphitheatre, Els Vilars Fortress, Tikal; average download around 25GB per site; each dataset has DOI.
additions.access: No account; submit name/organization/email on project page and receive download links by email.
additions.rights: Dataset-level Creative Commons licenses; most datasets not commercial; some sites withheld due security/privacy or third-party rights.

additions.name: OGC API - Features
additions.content: Modern HTTP/OpenAPI/JSON/HTML standards for geospatial feature discovery and object-level query; GET /collections, /collections/{id}/items, /collections/{id}/items/{featureId}; Part 1 Core, Part 2 CRS, Part 3 Filtering/CQL2.
additions.access: Open standards; provider-deployed HTTP GET APIs and OpenAPI definitions.
additions.rights: Standard public; underlying datasets, authentication and reuse rights controlled by provider.

additions.name: SpatioTemporal Asset Catalog (STAC)
additions.content: Open metadata specification for spatial-temporal assets using Catalog/Collection/Item/Asset; describes time/geometry/platform/instruments/projection/resolution/cloud cover/bands and links for satellite/aerial/raster/point-cloud data.
additions.access: STAC JSON documents, Catalog/Collection/Item APIs, integrated with OData/openEO and cloud storage.
additions.rights: STAC specification open; asset file rights depend on provider and must be checked at collection/item/asset level.

additions.name: British Library Endangered Archives Programme (EAP)
additions.content: 500+ projects in 90+ countries and 100+ languages/scripts; 15m+ images and 35k sound tracks; rare printed sources, manuscripts, visual materials, audio and local archives; originals remain in source countries; IIIF manifests for all archive images.
additions.access: Free web discovery; IIIF Universal Viewer/Mirador; single JPEG download; low-res images/audio online; source custodians and local archive partners.
additions.rights: Copyrighted materials usually CC BY-NC 4.0; even public-domain originals require custodian permission for online publication; further sharing/publication and commercial use require owners/partners; metadata CC0 does not license media.

additions.name: Qatar Digital Library (QDL)
additions.provider: Qatar National Library / British Library / Qatar Foundation
additions.content: Gulf and wider Middle East archives, maps, Arabic manuscripts, audio, photographs and visual arts; politics, people, places, trade, culture and customs; includes Arabic scientific manuscripts from British Library; English and Arabic contextual essays.
additions.access: Free web search/browse; item pages link to source archival records; QNL Digital Repository provides Arabic manuscripts, early printed works, periodicals, maps and exploration materials.
additions.rights: Item content may be third-party copyright, QDL copyright, public domain or CC. Many editorial pages CC BY-NC 4.0; commercial use of cultural material requires prior informed consent from QDL, holding institutions, third parties and traditional custodians.

additions.name: HathiTrust Digital Library
additions.content: Global library digitized books, journals, government publications, dissertations and other works; Full View permits full reading, Limited/Search-only permits full-text search only; 6.8m volumes (~39%) Full View for US IP as of 2026.
additions.access: Web search/read; full-view downloads depend on copyright, digitizing source and member affiliation; bibliographic API; HTRC computational environment for public-domain corpus.
additions.rights: Full View means public domain or rights-holder permission to read, not necessarily CC0 or full-volume download. Limited is search only. Download restrictions vary by digitizing agent, member status and geographic IP.

additions.name: National Cultural Heritage Administration Government Service Portal (heritage directory queries)
additions.provider: National Cultural Heritage Administration / National Government Service Platform
additions.content: Official directory services for historic cities/towns/villages/streets, World Heritage, national key cultural relics protection units, museums, collections, revolutionary heritage areas and related agencies; national key protected units query fields include name/category/batch and result fields number/name/era/address/category/batch.
additions.access: Web query pages; name/category/batch filters and captcha; no public API or bulk export verified. Default query currently returns zero rows until filters submitted.
additions.rights: Official register discovery; no blanket open license or bulk reuse terms located; check specific published list and source before reuse.

additions.name: Chinese Archaeology Web (Institute of Archaeology, CASS)
additions.provider: Institute of Archaeology, Chinese Academy of Social Sciences / Chinese Academy of History
additions.content: Research portal with archaeology news, fieldwork, site studies, academic meetings, excavation report/publication information, science archaeology, heritage protection and overseas projects; CSSN full-text search returns about 8,447 results; 2026-05 Institute announced 13 excavation reports, 13 monographs/academic materials/popular books, 8 atlases/essay collections/datasets and 30+ journal reports/papers.
additions.access: Website search and article browsing; CSSN search index; original reports/books/data sets obtained from publisher or research institution; no public bulk API for raw excavation data found.
additions.rights: CSSN website states content may not be used without written authorization; articles/images/publications have separate rights. Browsing does not make raw excavation data open.

additions.name: National Earth System Science Data Center (NESSDC)
additions.provider: Institute of Geographic Sciences and Natural Resources Research, CAS and partners
additions.content: National earth-system science data sharing center across 18 disciplines and 115 thematic databases; official 2020 baseline 35,000+ datasets and 2.14PB; datasets include GIS, remote sensing, Landsat, DEM, river networks, basin boundaries, climate, hydrology and ecology; records include DOI/CSTR, docs, samples and citations.
additions.access: Web search, data samples, online orders with stated purpose and review, some direct downloads; full datasets may require order approval.
additions.rights: General terms restrict data to scientific research; no copying/modifying/dissemination/sale without written permission; cite and acknowledge source; individual datasets may add contributor terms.

additions.name: Yangtze River (Jiujiang-Hukou to Yangtze Estuary) 1970-1979 time-series remote sensing dataset
additions.content: 358MB Landsat time series for the Yangtze from Jiujiang-Hukou to the estuary, 1970-1979; compiled from project-purchased and publicly downloaded imagery by year; includes docs, DOI and citation metadata.
additions.access: Online data order, metadata/docs/sample; full dataset after review.
additions.rights: Mixed imagery sources; NESSDC research-only terms apply; commercial use/redistribution requires written permission and source image rights check.

additions.name: Yangtze River Basin river network dataset (2020)
additions.content: Vector river network for main Yangtze, tributaries, lake connections and major artificial waterways; data time 2020, size about 478KB, metadata updated 2026-03-25, DOI 10.12041/geodata.8828927.ver1.db and CSTR.
additions.access: Online order; DOI/CSTR, docs, sample and citation metadata.
additions.rights: NESSDC research-only terms; no copying/modification/dissemination/sale without written permission.

additions.name: China National Place Names Database (2022 edition)
additions.content: Official standard toponym database. 2022 release added 87,400 foreign standard-name translations, 89 international seabed names, 362 Antarctic names and 873 lunar names; updated 2,130 administrative changes, 103 boundary lines, 242 boundary markers; added 204,500 names and removed 194,000.
additions.access: MCA website/mini-program search; API/bulk export not verified.
additions.rights: Official announcement invites public use but no blanket CC/commercial license or bulk data license located; treat as authoritative name reference pending rights confirmation.

additions.name: Ministry of Civil Affairs Historical Place Name Query
additions.provider: Ministry of Civil Affairs / National Government Service Platform
additions.content: Official historical toponym query UI with name input and captcha; result fields include sequence, place name, place code, romanized spelling and type; default page currently returns no results.
additions.access: Web query by name plus captcha; no API or bulk export verified.
additions.rights: Data source, result availability, update frequency and reuse license unverified; do not treat as operational bulk historical gazetteer until specific queries succeed.

additions.name: National Geospatial Information Resource Catalog Service System
additions.provider: Ministry of Natural Resources / National Geomatics Center of China
additions.content: National geospatial catalog; 1:250k public edition covers 816 map sheets nationwide and major islands/coastal waters, currentness 2012, CGCS2000 and 1985 elevation datum; seven feature classes include provincial/city/county admin units, boundary lines/points, settlement names and natural names; 716,785 settlement and 648,565 natural place-name features; some public data downloadable.
additions.access: Catalog search; partial 1:250k public data downloads; other products may require application/authorization.
additions.rights: Website reserves rights and prohibits unauthorized copying/mirroring; partial free download does not imply commercial/republication rights; check product terms.

additions.name: Tianditu (Map World)
additions.provider: Ministry of Natural Resources / National Geomatics Center and provincial nodes
additions.content: National geospatial service with vector/imagery/terrain maps, place names, boundaries, administrative divisions, roads, waterways, geocoding and reverse geocoding APIs; 2025 official explanation cites 1.24m developer registrations, 1m authorized apps and >1bn daily API calls.

methods.scope: 1900-1925 historical recordings and sound culture

methods.scope: JSTOR open journals, OA books, Early Journal Content, primary sources and images

methods.path: DOAB search → CC0 metadata export/OAI-PMH → publisher full-text license check
methods.scope: Discovery and cross-publisher metadata for OA academic books

methods.scope: OA academic monographs and chapters, with metadata
methods.steps: Filter by subject/language/publisher; use JSON/CSV/MARCXML or OAI-PMH; select records with download links; inspect PDF/EPUB and CC license; record version and publisher.
methods.limits: Metadata CC0; book full-text license varies; some records have no full-text link.

methods.path: OpenAlex API targeted search → author/institution/topic/citation graph → OA location/license filter
methods.scope: Global scholarly metadata and relationships, not a full-text archive

methods.limits: API budget limits; 2026-09 snapshot about 745GB JSONL compressed; core vs expansion counts differ; CC0 metadata does not license full text.

methods.scope: UK/Ireland archaeology, historic environment, reports, raw project data, GIS and imagery

methods.limits: Legacy ADS terms differ from CC BY/OGL; attribution and no-sale restrictions; not every record has a file.

methods.scope: Cross-institution archaeological discovery and metadata for sites, artefacts, reports and scientific datasets

methods.scope: Archaeological artefact/ecofact, field notes, images, maps, vocabularies and research data

methods.limits: Licenses vary per dataset; publisher service fees are for depositors; community-sensitive data require care.

methods.scope: Historical toponyms, aliases, geometries, temporal bounds and multi-gazetteer relations

methods.limits: Most v4 endpoints require token; mixed source licenses; deprecated v3 endpoints; 503 is upstream temporary failure, not 404.

methods.path: Pleiades web/API → JSON/GIS CSV/RDF download → numbered release citation
methods.scope: Ancient world historical places, names, locations, connections and bibliography
methods.steps: Search ancient/modern names and region; fetch item JSON/GeoJSON; bulk use full JSON or GIS CSV; static scholarship cites quarterly numbered release; dynamic queries use current daily JSON; provide CC BY attribution.
methods.limits: Ancient world focus, not all-period global gazetteer; legacy CSV deprecated; static releases lag live data.

methods.path: Harvard Geospatial Library search → GeoTIFF/GIS download → access/license check
methods.scope: Global historical maps, GeoTIFF and thematic GIS
methods.steps: Search by place/topic/date/data type; inspect format, CRS, license and access; download when permitted; restricted data discovered via HOLLIS/Map Collection Reading Room.
methods.limits: Some data not in HGL due license/copyright/format; some require onsite access.

methods.path: SNAC web/API/OpenRefine → person/family/corporate body → original archival collection
methods.scope: Global historical persons, families, organizations and archival links
methods.steps: Search names/families/organizations; inspect aliases, relations, institutions and Resources; use API/OpenRefine for matching; follow links to source archive; record original source and rights separately.
methods.limits: SNAC records CC0 but not linked originals; duplicates and identity ambiguity require source verification.

methods.path: VIAF API → cluster/source records → national authority reconciliation
methods.scope: Multilingual authority names and cross-national identity linking
methods.steps: Search local/preferred name/title/source/control number; compare cluster and source records; preserve agency IDs, variants and ODC-By attribution; verify biography/identity through other sources.
methods.limits: Authority file is not full biography/social graph; possible false merges for namesakes.

methods.path: Getty ULAN web/SPARQL/OpenRefine → LOD records → ODC-By attribution
methods.scope: Artists, architects, makers, studios, patrons and visual culture institutions
methods.steps: Search name/role/nationality; retrieve preferred/variant names, roles, nationality, dates, biography and relations; reconcile via SPARQL/OpenRefine; use monthly N-Triples and cite Getty/contributors.
methods.limits: Not a general people database; linked images/biographies may have separate rights; legacy XML services discontinued.

methods.path: PoMS database → persons/factoids/documents/relations → RDF snapshot
methods.scope: 1093-1371 Scotland persons and documentary relationships
methods.steps: Search person/place/source/factoid; inspect role/date/document/related persons; use network graph/map; if using RDF, record 2020 snapshot and CC BY; verify original charter rights at holding institution.
methods.limits: RDF snapshot differs from live site; charter images require separate rights.

methods.path: PASE relational database → person/relations/groups → source text verification
methods.scope: Late 6th to late 11th century England persons, relations and groups
methods.steps: Search persons/relations/groups; record source type; trace chronicles, charters, inscriptions, coins and other sources; contact maintainer before bulk or commercial reuse.
methods.limits: No clear open license or public bulk API confirmed; public browsing does not imply reuse rights.

methods.path: PBW search → factoids/persons/narratives/seals → source and access terms check
methods.scope: 1025-1204 Byzantine persons, factoids, narrative units and seals
methods.steps: Search person/date/event/seal; inspect linked factoids, dates, reigns and sources; record database version; use only limited personal research/academic quotation unless permission is obtained.
methods.limits: 2016 version; institutional access may be required; no open bulk reuse license confirmed.

methods.path: IIIF Image/Presentation Manifest → image service and item rights check
methods.scope: IIIF images, compound objects, manifests, annotations and change discovery
methods.steps: Locate Manifest; inspect Canvas/Sequence/Range/Metadata/Rights/Service; read info.json; request region/size; use Content Search; check Auth Flow and source rights.
methods.limits: IIIF is not a content license; image access and reuse controlled by provider.

methods.path: PAGE-XML structure inspection → source image/layout/text/confidence interpretation
methods.scope: Page layout, OCR/HTR results, coordinates, reading order and processing history
methods.steps: Inspect PcGts/Page, source image, TextRegion/TextLine/Word/Glyph, Coords, ReadingOrder, TextEquiv/Unicode, confidence and AlternativeImage; record schema version and METS references.
methods.limits: Coordinates depend on source image; transformations must map AlternativeImage; format openness does not license source content.

methods.path: ALTO XML schema/version check → layout/OCR field interpretation
methods.scope: Printed text page layout, OCR text, coordinates, styles and reading order
methods.steps: Inspect Page/PrintSpace/TextBlock/TextLine/String and position fields; verify versioned XSD, METS association and coordinate units.
methods.limits: Official page has v4.4 Official vs old current-version 4.3 label; old alto.xsd may point to old schema; source content rights separate.

methods.path: Copernicus OData/STAC/openEO → Sentinel collection and license check
methods.scope: Sentinel satellite data and cloud EO services
methods.steps: Search by place/date/cloud/product level; read Collection/Item; locate assets through OData/STAC; evaluate openEO if processing needed; apply Sentinel Data Legal Notice and attribution; separate third-party/portal content.
methods.limits: Sentinel mainly from 2014; STAC covers limited collections; portal content has non-commercial terms.

methods.path: USGS EarthExplorer/M2M/AWS → Landsat and aerial imagery by time/AOI
methods.scope: Landsat 1972-present, aerial photos 1937-present and EROS datasets
methods.steps: Search AOI/date/dataset; preview; choose Collection 2 L1/L2/ARD/DEM; use EarthExplorer/M2M; record scene ID/sensor/processing level/date; check rights of non-Landsat datasets.
methods.limits: Only Landsat is confirmed public domain; other EarthExplorer datasets vary; cloud processing/storage may cost.

methods.path: Open Heritage 3D project search → data types/DOI/CC license → request download if needed
methods.scope: Cultural heritage LiDAR, photogrammetry and 3D spatial source data
methods.steps: Search site/country/contributor; inspect data type/date/DOI/CC license; request download only when needed; use CC BY-NC only for non-commercial research; select CC BY or permission for commercial works.
methods.limits: Most datasets non-commercial; average 25GB; some withheld for security/privacy/third-party rights.

methods.path: OGC API Features capability discovery → collections/items/feature query → provider rights
methods.scope: Standardized web API for geospatial feature access
methods.steps: Inspect OpenAPI; GET collections; query collection items; retrieve single feature geometry/attributes/CRS; record extent and license; do not treat standard as content provider.
methods.limits: Standard does not provide data/license; provider implementations differ in CRS/auth/query.

methods.path: STAC Catalog/Collection/Item → spatiotemporal asset metadata and file links
methods.scope: Remote sensing/aerial/raster/point-cloud asset metadata
methods.steps: Read Catalog/Collection/Item JSON; inspect geometry/datetime/platform/instruments/proj/eo/raster/assets/license; query STAC API by time/area; follow asset href to source and check rights.
methods.limits: STAC only describes/discovers assets; access/download/commercial rights depend on provider and item/asset.

methods.path: EAP website/IIIF Manifest → image browse/download → custodian rights check
methods.scope: Global endangered local archives, manuscripts, rare print, visual and audio materials
methods.steps: Search by country/project/archive type; read item/file page and IIIF Manifest; browse via Mirador/Universal Viewer; use JPEG only for personal study; contact custodian/partner before publishing, sharing or commercial use; keep metadata CC0 separate from media rights.
methods.limits: Most copyright material CC BY-NC; even public-domain material requires custodian permission; commercial requests referred to archive owners/partners.

methods.path: QDL web search → item Rights Statement → source archive/cultural ethics permission
methods.scope: Gulf/Middle East archives, Arabic manuscripts, maps, audio and photos
methods.steps: Search by person/place/trade/science/manuscript; inspect object page and Usage Terms; distinguish primary material from editorial article; check PD/CC/third-party rights; commercial use requires prior informed consent from QDL, institution, third parties and traditional custodians.
methods.limits: Free website does not mean all content commercial; many articles CC BY-NC; cultural heritage ethics apply.

methods.path: HathiTrust search → Full View/Limited status → download rights and digitization source check
methods.scope: Global books, journals, government publications, dissertations and OCR text
methods.steps: Search title/author/place/date/subject; record Full View/Limited and IP region; inspect rights determination; check digitizing source before full-volume download; use HTRC only within account/member and public-domain corpus rules.
methods.limits: Full View not always full download; Limited is search only; Google scan agreements and member status restrict downloads; region affects rights.

methods.path: NCHA government service portal → heritage register query → field/update/license verification
methods.scope: National key protected units, museums, historic cities/towns/villages/streets and heritage registers
methods.steps: Select register; search by name/category/batch; record number/name/era/address/category/batch; check update date and source document; preserve query date; confirm license before reuse.
methods.limits: Captcha; default page shows zero results; no public API/bulk export verified; official register page does not provide blanket reuse terms.

methods.path: Chinese Archaeology Web/CSSN search → project/publication discovery → source institution verification
methods.scope: Chinese archaeology research, fieldwork news, reports, monographs, atlases, datasets and overseas archaeology
methods.steps: Search by site/region/date/project/institution; record author/date/source; track reports/datasets/lab journals; return to Institute/publisher/project for full text, raw data and rights; do not treat news as primary excavation data.
methods.limits: Portal is research discovery, not raw-data repository; content copyright restricted; no public bulk raw-data API found.

methods.path: NESSDC search → DOI/CSTR/sample → order and research/commercial rights check
methods.scope: China GIS, remote sensing, river networks, DEM, hydrology/climate/ecology datasets
methods.steps: Search by basin/region/time/topic; inspect DOI/CSTR, contributor, temporal/spatial extent, docs, sample and citation; distinguish sample/full data; place order only if needed; obtain written permission for commercial use.
methods.limits: 2020 total volume baseline is old; platform research-only terms; full data may need approval; contributor terms may differ.

methods.path: 1970-1979 Yangtze remote sensing metadata → DOI/docs → order and source imagery rights check
methods.scope: Landsat time series from Jiujiang-Hukou to Yangtze Estuary
methods.steps: Check time/area/DOI/CSTR/docs/image inventory and source; order only if needed; verify rights of purchased and public imagery; require written permission for commercial use.
methods.limits: Mixed image sources; research-only terms; no bytes acquired.

methods.path: Yangtze river network dataset metadata → DOI/CSTR → order/license/version check
methods.scope: Main/tributary/lake-connection/artificial river vector data
methods.steps: Read feature scope/data time/DOI/CSTR/CRS/docs/citation; order if needed; compare as modern baseline with historical maps and older imagery; check written permission for commercial use.
methods.limits: 2020 data is not a historical river reconstruction; research-only terms.

methods.path: National Place Names Database → standard name/code/admin reference → version/license check
methods.scope: China standard toponyms, codes, romanization, administrative divisions and boundaries
methods.steps: Search standard names; record name/code/spelling/type/admin division; compare with 2022 announcement changes; contact MCA for bulk/API and commercial permission.
methods.limits: 2022 version may be stale; standard gazetteer is not historical toponym evolution; no blanket reuse license.

methods.path: MCA historical place name query → specific-name validation → source/license verification
methods.scope: Official historical toponym query UI
methods.steps: Test specific known historical names; capture result name/code/romanization/type; identify source, historical date, update and rights; keep as identified-only until results are verified.
methods.limits: Default no results; captcha; no API/bulk; data source and license unknown.

methods.path: National geospatial catalog → 1:250k public map sheets/features → data version and rights check
methods.scope: National basic geospatial data, boundaries, toponyms, waterways, roads and terrain
methods.steps: Search catalog; record scale/sheet/coverage/CRS/datum/currentness/features; check public edition and download; verify product license before commercial use.
methods.limits: 2012 currentness; partial public download; copying/mirroring and commercial/republication rights not confirmed.

methods.path: Tianditu developer service → API/Key/quota → node and commercial authorization check
methods.scope: National map/imagery/terrain/place-name/road/waterway/geocoding services
methods.steps: Select map/web/WEB/data API; register developer and request Key; inspect service resources; confirm quotas, commercial authorization, caching and tile redistribution restrictions; record node and terms version.
methods.limits: Online API service is not open data download; Key/quota and provincial-node terms differ; no default offline/rehosting rights.

methods.path: Tianditu Shanghai node → multitemporal imagery/catalog/data API → Shanghai terms check
methods.scope: Shanghai vector/imagery/terrain/land cover/multitemporal imagery and geospatial services
methods.steps: Browse map service, thematic channels, results catalog and multitemporal imagery; record layer source/time/map approval number; request Key for API; check Shanghai node terms and underlying rights; do not cache/republish tiles commercially.
methods.limits: Prohibits commercial promotion; timeliness not guaranteed; not a historical map or open-download repository.

methods.path: Zenodo search → DOI/version/file-level license → download/restriction check
methods.scope: Global research datasets, publications, software, reports and multimedia
methods.steps: Search by topic/author/institution/DOI; inspect record metadata, version, files, access_right, license and embargo; cite specific DOI version; verify file license and restricted status before reuse.
methods.limits: Metadata CC0 does not cover files; files may be embargoed/restricted/closed; licenses differ per record/file.

methods.path: Harvard Dataverse search → Dataset/Version/File → license/access level verification
methods.scope: Humanities, archaeology, history, GIS and social science datasets
methods.steps: Search by keyword/author/institution; inspect dataset citation, version, files, terms/license and access status; use Search/Native API for metadata; request restricted files; verify commercial reuse at dataset/file level.
methods.limits: Default CC0 is not universal; custom licenses, embargo and privacy restrictions apply.

methods.path: OpenAIRE Explore/Graph API → publication/data/software/project relations → source verification
methods.scope: Global scholarly outputs, research data, software, projects, organizations and funders
methods.steps: Search by topic/author/institution/project; follow publication-dataset-software relations; inspect source repository, license, DOI and OA link; attribute OpenAIRE metadata; verify full text at source.
methods.limits: Graph metadata CC BY 4.0 does not license underlying content; source records may be incomplete.

methods.path: DOAJ journal/article search → inclusion and article license → publisher full text check
methods.scope: Global OA journals/articles and full-text links
methods.steps: Search by subject/country/journal/article; inspect journal status, publisher, DOI, article license and full-text URL; verify article rights at publisher; use DOAJ metadata under CC0.
methods.limits: DOAJ is an index; journal inclusion does not make all articles commercially reusable; article-level rights required.

methods.path: CORE search/API → OA version/source repository/data dump → full-text license check
methods.scope: Global institutional repositories and OA journal paper discovery
methods.steps: Search by topic/author/DOI; inspect repository source, version, full-text URL, license and OAI ID; use API/dump with CORE attribution; verify full text at source; request commercial service license if needed.
methods.limits: ODC-BY aggregate data does not license article full text; commercial services are separately licensed.

methods.path: Digital Dunhuang resource library → cave/mural browse → source image rights verification
methods.scope: 30 classic caves with whole-cave high-resolution mural digitization and scholarly context
methods.steps: Search cave/period/mural; record cave number/date/subject/object description/link; use web browse as discovery/citation only; route high-resolution asset requests to Open Materials Library; cite Dunhuang Academy.
methods.limits: Online browsing is not download/commercial permission; no blanket CC license or bulk API verified.

methods.path: Digital Dunhuang Open Materials → item/use-case application → agreement/fee/download authorization
methods.scope: High-resolution cave/mural/manuscript/creative assets and co-created works
methods.steps: Register; browse low-res; select asset and intended use; sign electronic authorization and pay; download after approval; attribute Dunhuang Academy; do not transfer or provide to third parties; check special restrictions on whole cave/wall and 300dpi+ images.
methods.limits: Open Materials means browse/apply, not CC open license; commercial use separately negotiated; no scraping/republication without written authorization.

methods.path: GCdataPR论文页 → DOI数据集记录 → XLSX/SHP文件获取
methods.scope: 京杭大运河沿线697处文化遗产点的结构化属性与空间数据
methods.steps: 先读数据论文和数据集元数据；核验文件清单、坐标参考系、字段字典和数据版本；经DOI进入数据集记录并取得文件；保存发布页与共享政策；引用数据集；再分发或纳入新数据集前申请书面许可并核对10%原则。
methods.limits: GCdataPR论文规定免费获取并引用；再分发需书面许可及数据再分发许可证；新数据集遵守10%原则。坐标服务初值GCJ-02，论文称经校准后为WGS84；实际文件需核对坐标参考、缺失/重复记录和14项字段。商业使用边界按具体用途确认。未下载、未校验SHA256。

methods.path: GCdataPR数据详情页 → DOI/CSTR → RAR数据包下载
methods.scope: 全国重点文物保护单位5058处空间分布SHP/XLS数据
methods.steps: 核对八批国务院名录来源与数据版本；保存数据详情、DOI/CSTR及文件列表；下载RAR和数据说明；检查SHP坐标系、属性字段、记录数和文件完整性；联系发布方核实许可。
methods.limits: GCdataPR论文明确：免费在线获取并引用；再分发须编辑部书面许可和数据再分发许可证；用于新数据集须遵守10%原则并标注来源。商业使用边界未单独明确，需按用途确认。坐标来自百度地图Place API地理编码并由BD09转WGS84，行政区使用当前边界反向地理编码；数据不含港澳台。论文Index示例0—5065与名义5058项存在需实物核验的差异；县级空间粒度，不得当作测绘级点位/遗址边界。未下载、未校验SHA256。

methods.path: GCdataPR数据目录 → Neolithic human activity dataset DOI → NetCDF
methods.scope: 北方新石器时代考古遗址密度及空间统计数据
methods.steps: 核验DOI/CSTR、数据论文和NetCDF元数据；明确0.5°网格尺度、文化分类和统计变量；取得NetCDF后检查维度、变量、缺失值编码和坐标范围；保留引用与权利证据。
methods.limits: 13185是原始地点描述基础数量，不是发布文件中的点位记录数；发布成果为0.5°网格统计。许可条款未核清；未实测下载与哈希。

methods.path: GCdataPR数据论文 → 数据集DOI/CSTR → XLSX/SHP文件获取
methods.scope: 河西走廊新石器时代至清代古遗址/古城、灾害、饥荒、战争与人口历史记录
methods.steps: 先阅读数据论文和数据集元数据；核对三组数据表、时间范围、空间粒度、古遗址点位数量和字段说明；经DOI/CSTR进入数据产品并取得文件；检查SHP坐标、行政区归属、时间表达和记录来源；保留引用；再分发或将数据纳入新数据集前取得书面许可并遵守10%原则。
methods.limits: 作者明确指出时空不匹配、史料歧义、行政区边界变迁、历史记录冲突会影响分析，县乡尺度精度较低；部分人口序列为基于既有研究推算。数据不能作为无误差的逐事件事实底库；未下载、未计算SHA256。 论文正文与元数据表对文件格式的表述不完全一致（正文称XLSX，元数据列XLSX/SHP），需下载后核对实际文件清单。

methods.path: XRONOS官网数据入口 → 数据查询/导出；或Zenodo归档记录 → CSV下载
methods.scope: 全球考古放射性碳测年及相关年代学记录、遗址元数据与来源关系
methods.steps: 先确认官网当前数据版本、日期/遗址计数口径和数据政策；分别识别动态在线数据库与Zenodo历史快照；下载CSV或使用官方数据导出；保存版本号、发布时间、文件大小、MD5/其他校验信息；取得字节后计算SHA256并检查字段、记录数、重复、缺失、实验室编号、样品材料、年代值、校准信息、遗址坐标、来源文献和版本追踪字段；抽查记录回溯至原始发表来源。
methods.limits: Zenodo快照85.3MB，网页读取器因文件超过4MB限制未能直接读取，容器下载尝试也未取得文件；无SHA256。Zenodo归档页License字段未明确，官网CC BY 4.0声明不能自动替代文件级许可核验。动态官网与2025归档快照版本不同；数据来自多来源整合，需检查来源可追溯性、重复合并和版本更新。
